# MarvinApps — Software a la medida que pone orden en tu negocio.

Diseño y construyo sistemas de gestión, aplicaciones web e integraciones para empresas que quieren dejar el papel y las hojas de cálculo, y crecer con datos claros.

## Soluciones de punta a punta

### Software a la medida
Sistemas diseñados alrededor de cómo trabaja tu negocio, no al revés: ERP, puntos de venta, gestión de operaciones e inventarios.
- Levantamiento de procesos
- Multisede y roles
- Reportes para decidir

### Aplicaciones web y SaaS
Plataformas en la nube que funcionan en computador, tablet y celular desde el navegador, sin instalar nada.
- Diseño adaptable y modo oscuro
- Tiempo real
- Apps instalables (PWA)

### Integraciones y APIs
Conecto tu software con WhatsApp, pasarelas de pago, facturación electrónica DIAN y los sistemas que ya usas.
- APIs REST robustas
- Automatización de procesos
- Notificaciones automáticas

### Arquitectura y backend en la nube
Backends escalables y seguros con la experiencia de haber construido servicios para plataformas de alto tráfico.
- Bases de datos y rendimiento
- Seguridad y trazabilidad
- Cumplimiento Ley 1581

### Consultoría y transformación digital
Te ayudo a decidir qué digitalizar primero, qué herramientas usar y cómo pasar del papel y las hojas de cálculo a un sistema.
- Diagnóstico tecnológico
- Hoja de ruta
- Capacitación de equipos

### Soporte y evolución
Acompañamiento después del lanzamiento: mantenimiento, mejoras continuas y nuevas funcionalidades según crece tu negocio.
- Monitoreo y respaldos
- Mejoras por etapas
- Atención directa

## Cómo trabajamos juntos

1. **Descubrimiento**: Entiendo tu operación, tus dolores y tus metas. Definimos alcance, prioridades y presupuesto.
2. **Diseño**: Prototipo las pantallas y la arquitectura para validar la solución antes de escribir código.
3. **Desarrollo por etapas**: Entregas frecuentes que puedes probar. Ves el avance real, no solo informes.
4. **Lanzamiento y acompañamiento**: Puesta en marcha, capacitación a tu equipo y soporte para que el sistema crezca contigo.

## Experiencia en sectores reales

- Talleres y servicio automotriz
- Restaurantes, cafés y bares
- Lavaderos y servicios por turno
- Comercio y retail
- Educación y formación
- Entretenimiento digital

He construido servicios para Mercado Libre, Robin Food y Domicilios.com. Hoy llevo esa experiencia a empresas que necesitan software confiable sin la burocracia de una gran agencia.

- Hablas directamente con quien construye tu sistema
- Entregas por etapas que puedes probar
- Código tuyo, documentado y mantenible

# MarvinApps — Custom software that brings order to your business.

I design and build management systems, web applications and integrations for companies that want to leave paper and spreadsheets behind and grow with clear data.

## End-to-end solutions

### Custom software
Systems designed around the way your business works, not the other way around: ERP, point of sale, operations and inventory management.
- Process discovery
- Multi-branch and roles
- Reports for decision-making

### Web apps and SaaS
Cloud platforms that run on desktop, tablet and phone right from the browser, with nothing to install.
- Responsive design and dark mode
- Real time
- Installable apps (PWA)

### Integrations and APIs
I connect your software with WhatsApp, payment gateways, DIAN electronic invoicing and the systems you already use.
- Robust REST APIs
- Process automation
- Automatic notifications

### Cloud architecture and backend
Scalable, secure backends built with the experience of creating services for high-traffic platforms.
- Databases and performance
- Security and traceability
- Data-privacy compliance (Law 1581)

### Consulting and digital transformation
I help you decide what to digitize first, which tools to use and how to move from paper and spreadsheets to a real system.
- Technology assessment
- Roadmap
- Team training

### Support and evolution
Ongoing support after launch: maintenance, continuous improvements and new features as your business grows.
- Monitoring and backups
- Incremental improvements
- Direct support

## How we work together

1. **Discovery**: I learn about your operation, pain points and goals. We define scope, priorities and budget.
2. **Design**: I prototype the screens and the architecture to validate the solution before writing code.
3. **Incremental development**: Frequent deliveries you can test. You see real progress, not just reports.
4. **Launch and support**: Go-live, training for your team and support so the system grows with you.

## Experience in real-world sectors

- Workshops and automotive service
- Restaurants, cafés and bars
- Car washes and appointment-based services
- Retail and commerce
- Education and training
- Digital entertainment

## Real products, running today

- **YOYO** (Workshop management): Management system for motorcycle maintenance workshops.
- **TATA** (Point of sale): The point of sale built for coffee shops and bars.
- **LAVATRONIC** (Car wash management): The management system for car and motorcycle washes.
- **CHEEKY** (18+ multiplayer game): A digital board game for adults, real-time and in 3D.

## Big-platform experience, the direct attention of a partner

I've built services for Mercado Libre, Robin Food and Domicilios.com. Today I bring that experience to companies that need reliable software without the bureaucracy of a large agency.

- You talk directly to the person building your system
- Incremental deliveries you can test
- Code you own, documented and maintainable

## Engineering with a teacher's mindset — Marvin David Delgado

MarvinApps is the brand of Marvin David Delgado: software engineer, backend architect and university lecturer.

For more than eight years I've been designing and building scalable backend systems, robust APIs and maintainable architectures at high-traffic companies such as Mercado Libre.

Today I put that experience to work for companies that need their own software: products like YOYO, TATA and LAVATRONIC were born from listening to business owners and turning their daily operation into a simple system.

As a university lecturer, explaining things clearly is part of my job: you'll always know what is being built and why.

### Where I've built software

- 2025 – — **Corporación Universitaria Republicana**: University lecturer in programming, databases, cybersecurity and software engineering.
- 2022 – 2025 — **Mercado Libre**: Backend APIs and services for help centers and FAQs.
- 2019 – 2022 — **Robin Food Colombia**: Internal management and kitchen administration systems for the MUY restaurant chain.
- 2018 – 2019 — **Domicilios.com**: Backend integrations with each store's external systems.

### How I like to work

- **Clarity**: I explain every decision in plain language.
- **Quality**: Maintainable, tested and documented code.
- **Commitment**: Your project is treated as if it were my own.
